column2: [name:50]I was only following the great Ice Apostle's orders.[wait][page]If you want to know more, you'll have to beat me!![wait][page]Here I come!! DemiKid![wait][end]
[name:49]The great Ice Apostle commands it.[wait][page]Give up on Lena and go back to your own world quietly.[wait][page]Otherwise, I'll have to put you to sleep right here.[wait][end]
[name:26]Because of the fighting, my mom and dad[wait][clr]are gone.[wait][page]And Sis Sek went off somewhere and never came back.[wait][end]
[name:26]No, Sis Sek! He's not like that!![wait][page]He's trying to help me.[wait][end]
